oneLineCopy: Your list sorts itself — by what actually matters right now.

hero.headlineSerifLead: Not 43 open items and the question of where to start — the three that make the difference today.

founderScenario.story: 43 open tasks. Daniel scrolls through for the fourth time, reorders once, then does the smallest one — because it feels like progress. The task that decides the month has been sitting at position 19 for eleven days.

benefits: You see three tasks, not forty-three
Deadlines, dependencies and effort feed the order automatically
What you can genuinely finish today fits the time you actually have today
Tasks born in mails and documents land in the list by themselves
Nothing disappears — it just moves to where it belongs
howSteps: Tasks appear: from mails, documents, conversations, or because you told your Aven
Your Aven estimates effort, deadline and what depends on what
It re-sorts the list — every morning, and whenever something changes
You get the next three things, not the whole wall

whatMechanics.input: Tasks from email ingestor, docs organizer and whatever you hand your Aven
whatMechanics.magic: Effort estimation → deadlines and dependencies → available time from the calendar → continuous re-ranking
whatMechanics.output: A daily list that fits the day · the rest, ordered and not forgotten

playsWith.relation: Whatever is due today gets a real block in the calendar
Mails become tasks without you retyping them
Who is waiting on what — and since when
What your Aven may not decide lands with you

valueStack.timeDelayToValue: The first sorted list the morning after you start
valueStack.effortToInstall: No setup — your tasks are already appearing inside your Aven
valueStack.proof: Still in the workshop: todo shuffler runs in our own days before it runs in yours.

bonuses: Weekly review: what you finished — and what you postponed for eleven days
Reality check: planned more than the day holds? Your Aven says so beforehand
Quiet tasks: the small stuff your Aven simply handles without asking
scarcity: todo shuffler comes with avenME — no second app, no second subscription for your own list.
letterFromPublisher: The most honest number in Daniel's life was 19 for a long time: the position of the most important task while he ticked off the small ones. A list that doesn't sort itself sorts you instead. I'm turning that around.
